intro.title: Your trusted partner in global travel solutions
intro.subtitle: Innovative & powerful online airline ticket software
intro.text: Empowering travel agencies and tour operators with a cutting-edge flight ticketing solution, AirviaTech offers seamless access to all airlines and GDS systems in one powerful platform. Accelerate your ticketing processes, enhance operational efficiency, and unlock limitless connectivity with our next-generation technology.

pillars.title: Access to {{airlines}} airlines
pillars.text: Effortlessly integrate with major GDS providers like Travelport (Galileo), Sabre and Amadeus, alongside top airlines such as Turkish Airlines, AJet, SunExpress, Pegasus, Air France, Emirates, Singapore Airlines and more.

pillars.title: Flight ticket management
pillars.text: Unify and streamline all your ticketing operations across GDS terminals and airline agency screens in one easy-to-use system. Gain full visibility, improve efficiency, and stay in control with our advanced management solution.
pillars.tagline: One platform, total control, maximum efficiency

pillars.title: Infrastructure
pillars.text: Designed with the latest technology, AirviaTech delivers a powerful, flexible and scalable infrastructure to optimize global booking operations effortlessly — next-generation infrastructure for maximum performance.

distribution.title: Flight ticket service providers
distribution.text: With powerful GDS and direct airline integrations, AirviaTech connects you to a vast network of airlines worldwide through multiple IATA and agency accounts. And we're growing every day, adding new airlines to further expand your reach.

certification.eyebrow: IATA ARM · System Provider for Sellers
certification.title: Türkiye's first and only IATA-certified aggregator
certification.text: AirviaTech has been officially recognised under IATA's Airline Retailing Maturity (ARM) Index as a System Provider for Sellers — confirming that airline content is delivered through a transparent, neutral and standards-compliant infrastructure.

solutions.title: Unlock the future of travel with AirviaTech
solutions.text: We're redefining the travel industry with cutting-edge technology and a fully integrated system designed to elevate your business. Whether you're an IATA-accredited agency, a corporate travel provider or a B2C platform, we deliver seamless, high-performance solutions tailored to your needs.
